baseline_models.focus_anchor: The linked clauses 'His is the dominion of the heavens and the earth,' 'He gives life and causes death,' and 'over every thing powerful.'
baseline_models.mechanism: Comprehensive sovereignty spans the upper and lower cosmos; giving and withdrawing life are direct exercises of effective capacity within that owned totality.

activation_trace.role: Sovereignty and rule make the opening claim active dominion, not mere possession.
What is above and overshadowing supplies the upper extent of the domain.
The lower realm opposite heaven closes the vertical totality.
Living beings and spirit-bearing life supply the positive transition enacted by the ruler.
Loss of force and life supplies the opposed transition under the same agency.
Enclosure of all parts makes the scope exhaustive.
Anything knowable or reportable supplies the unrestricted object class.
Effective capacity links dominion to the ability to realize both transitions.

changed_reading.before: A static list of divine attributes.
changed_reading.after: A causal sovereignty claim: the whole vertical cosmos belongs to Him, and life and death display effective agency over every possible object.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The lexical range of mulk, giving life, causing death, and qadir within 57:2.
baseline_models.mechanism: A form-distant material reading treats dominion as what holds an order together, life as activated fertility, death as withdrawn force, and capacity as exact sizing and prior arrangement.

activation_trace.role: Tensile strength and cohesion recast dominion as the holding-together of an order.
Rain-fed vitality supplies a material image of activation and flourishing.
Weakening or extinguishing force supplies controlled deactivation rather than only organismal death.
A thing reaching its exact limit supplies bounded measure.
Deliberate estimation and arrangement give that measure an ordering function.

changed_reading.before: Power means undifferentiated ability to do anything.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, power is calibrated maintenance: holding the cosmos together while activating and withdrawing its vital forces by measure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah adds temporal endpoints and perceptual opposites, expanding the heavens-earth totality into rule across beginning/end and disclosed/hidden states.

activation_trace.role: The focus sovereignty is the model being expanded across further axes.
Beginning and precedence supply one temporal endpoint.
Lastness after the first supplies the opposite temporal endpoint.
Emergence and disclosure supply the manifest side of reality.
Hidden inwardness supplies the concealed side of reality.

structural_cues: 57:3 immediately follows 57:2 with two balanced pairs and repeats the construction 'every thing.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired extremes; I infer that they function meristically to extend the focus totality, while they could instead remain four independent predicates.

changed_reading.after: Dominion is axis-complete enclosure: spatial, temporal, manifest, and hidden domains all lie within the capacity asserted in 57:2.

context_deltas.mechanism: Paired entry/exit, descent/ascent, reciprocal night-day ingress, and the return of affairs turn sovereignty from a title into continuous bidirectional administration; life/death become one transition pair within that traffic.

activation_trace.role: Giving life anchors the model in one focus transition.
Causing death supplies its opposed focus transition.
Ingress into another domain supplies inward traffic through the earth boundary.
Passage outward supplies the reverse traffic.
Descent and arrival supply downward traffic from heaven.
Ascent supplies its upward reverse.
Return gathers all affairs back toward the sovereign center.
Repeated reciprocal ingress makes alternation itself an administered process.

structural_cues: 57:5 repeats the focus ownership formula before all affairs return; 57:6 then reverses night and day into each other.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies movement pairs, recurrence, and return; I infer a circulation governed by the focus sovereign, while a live alternative reads them only as separate signs of knowledge and power.

changed_reading.before: Giving life and causing death are isolated punctual acts.
changed_reading.after: They are the biological edge of a wider administered circulation in which things cross, reverse, alternate, and return throughout the owned cosmos.

context_deltas.mechanism: Humans occupy property as successors while the heavens and earth finally pass as God's inheritance; the focus ownership claim therefore limits human possession to temporary tenure and makes spending its practical acknowledgment.

activation_trace.role: Ownership and disposal anchor the legal-social question of who truly holds property.
One party coming after and standing in another's place supplies temporary successor-holding.
Property passing from a predecessor to an inheritor supplies the terminal reversion of holdings.

structural_cues: 57:7 commands spending from what humans were made successors in; 57:10 asks why they do not spend and names God as inheritor of the same heavens and earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies succession, spending, and ultimate inheritance; I infer custodial tenure under the owner, while 'successors' could more narrowly denote one human generation replacing another.

changed_reading.before: The ownership formula describes only God's remote cosmic domain.
changed_reading.after: It also reclassifies human holdings inside that domain as temporary successor-possession whose release in spending recognizes the enduring owner.

context_deltas.mechanism: 57:17 recombines three focus roots into one visible sequence: the earth is revived after its death. The universal life/death claim acquires an ecological instance that can be observed and reasoned from.

activation_trace.role: The focus life verb already permits the specific image of land quickened by rain and growth.
Explicit revivification supplies the active phase of the land cycle.
Fertile, growing earth supplies the material patient of revival.
Dead uncultivated land supplies the prior inert state reversed by revival.

structural_cues: 57:17 repeats life, earth, and death from 57:2 in a single clause and then frames the demonstration as signs for reasoning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet explicitly supplies land revived after death; I take it as a concrete instantiation of 57:2, while it could function primarily as an independent proof of later resurrection.

changed_reading.before: The life/death pair is an abstract claim about organisms in general.
changed_reading.after: It is also experimentally legible in the recurring conversion of dead ground into living earth, a local display of the focus capacity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Events fixed in a record before being brought into existence, followed by the denial of creatures' control over divine bounty, sharpens qadir into exclusive effective capacity joined to prior determination.

activation_trace.role: The focus names effective capacity over every thing.
Estimation and prior arrangement supply a latent planning dimension within that capacity.
A fixed inscription carrying judgment or determination supplies prior specification.
Bringing into existence supplies the later realization of what was specified.
Negated creaturely control over any divine bounty sharpens the exclusivity of the focus capacity.

structural_cues: 57:22 orders inscription before bringing the event forth and calls that easy for God.
57:29 repeats the q-d-r capacity construction negatively for humans while locating bounty in God's hand and will.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies record-before-creation and a human/divine capacity contrast; I infer prior determination realized as events, while the record may alternatively denote knowledge without specifying a causal arrow.

changed_reading.before: Qadir denotes sheer ability at the moment of action.
changed_reading.after: Qadir also carries measured realization: what is specified beforehand can be brought forth, while competing human control over the result is denied.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it moves the cosmic life/death verbs into an affective register. It remains anchored by the focus branch of a deadened heart and by 57:16's hardened hearts immediately before 57:17's dead earth is revived; downstream prose should mark it as a sequence-driven analogy, not claim that 57:2 directly equates biological death with spiritual hardness.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The opposed focus verbs 'He gives life and causes death,' especially the m-w-t branch image of deadness of the heart.

activation_trace.role: Deadness of the heart through absent understanding opens an affective sense of the focus death verb.
Lowering and yielding supply the desired responsive state.
The heart is explicitly both the sought locus of yielding and the locus later hardened.
Loss of the heart's softness supplies a death-like resistant state.
Immediate revival of earth supplies the reversal image adjacent to heart-hardening.
The dead-land state makes the analogy's death-to-life sequence explicit.

changed_reading.before: The focus pair concerns only literal organismal life and death.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, divine enlivening can also name the softening of a deadened heart, patterned by living earth emerging from a death-like state.

strongest_changes: The ownership formula becomes continuous administration of crossings, reversals, alternation, and return.
Human property becomes temporary successor-possession under the enduring owner.
The life/death pair becomes observable in dead earth revived and, more cautiously, analogical for hardened hearts.
summary.what_was_special: The context repeatedly operationalized the focus's totalizing nouns and paired verbs: spatial ownership opened into multiple axes, moving systems, social tenure, ecological renewal, and measured realization without forcing those readings into one synthesis.
remaining_uncertainties: The cohesion reading of mulk is branch-distant from the surface noun and should remain exploratory.
The record-before-creation sequence supports prior determination, but does not by itself settle whether the record is causally efficacious or epistemic.
The heart-land activation depends on adjacency and lexical branch resonance rather than an explicit equation.
